call_points.text: FY27 growth guided above historical rates, with visibility into coming quarters.
40% EBITDA margin now seen in FY28, not within FY27.
API capacity addition decision when Unit 3 utilisation reaches 80–85%; only 20–25% of 160 acres used.
CDMO currently 1–2% of sales; target double-digit, with one project commercialised and one more expected this year.
Injectable facility can do close to ₹600 Cr top line; external sales expected in H2FY27.
Gross margin 78.9%, up 100 bps on pricing discipline and favourable mix.
Zero-debt balance sheet with over ₹442 Cr cash; Q1 capex about ₹9.5 Cr.
Injectable ramp-up was delayed by a couple of quarters last year on inspections and facility qualification.
ANDA approvals from U.S. FDA for mycophenolate mofetil and Tofacitinib tablets received in the quarter.
Middle East tender worth ₹25 Cr remains on hold; API supplies to the region gradually resuming.
Gross margin expected to remain in similar range, around historical levels.
CDMO contribution expected at 1-4% of revenue this year, with one opportunity in advanced discussions.

guidance.statement: FY27 growth expected slightly better than historical 18%
Solar power to add 1-1.5% to EBITDA margin
Growth to be better than historical growth rates
CDMO to become a double-digit contributor to sales

operating_notes.text: Capacity utilisation: Unit 1 at 77%, Unit 2 at 30%, Unit 3 at 53%.
CDMO revenue expected at 1-4% of total this year, with one opportunity in advanced discussions.
Power and fuel is about 20% of cost, of which close to 10% is LPG or furnace oil based.
Unit 1 capacity utilisation about 80%, Unit 3 about 55%, Unit 2 about 25% and injectables about 5% in Q1FY27.
CDMO is currently 1–2% of sales; one animal-health project is commercialised with a couple of million dollars of sales.
Injectable facility can do close to ₹600 Cr of top line; external sales expected in H2FY27 and emerging-market sales by next year.

timeline.summary: On its 3 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Concord Biotech reported revenue of ₹257 Cr (+26% YoY) and PAT of ₹58 Cr (+31%), guided FY27 growth above historical rates and pushed the 40% EBITDA margin target to FY28.

watchlist.response: Attributed to staggered customer procurement and shipment deferrals; expects moderation in H1 as supplies resume.
watchlist.text: Inventory days jumped to 480 from 286, with absolute inventory up to ₹326 Cr from ₹240 Cr.

watchlist.response: Depends on geopolitical situation; API supplies gradually resuming but no fixed timeline.
watchlist.text: Middle East tender and US Veterans Affairs tender remain on hold with no clarity on resumption.

watchlist.response: Full breakeven likely next financial year; operating leverage to start from FY27.
watchlist.text: Injectables and Stellon losses of ₹38-39 Cr and ₹10 Cr per quarter; when will breakeven occur?
